description: When collapseThreads=true and the fetch hits the 65536-email cap, the handler sets thread_total=None rather than returning a potentially wrong count. This is correct per RFC 8620 §5.5: if the server can't determine the true total it should omit it. A future contributor might be tempted to return the capped count as the total (which would be actively wrong) or to always compute the total regardless of cap. The None-on-truncation design is intentional and correct.
title: COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS cap with honest total=None on truncation
